title: Rock-Solid Lower Body
description: Anchored legs with squats and jump lunges, stability core work with shoulder tap plank and flutter kicks

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Deep squat hold
exercises.instructions: Hold a deep squat, back straight, elbows against the knees

exercises.name: Fast marching in place
exercises.instructions: March quickly in place while swinging the arms

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width apart, lower thighs parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Hip thrust on one leg, the other lifted in the air

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.instructions: Lean back, knees forward, quads on fire

exercises.name: Shoulder tap plank
exercises.instructions: In a high plank, touch the opposite shoulder alternating

exercises.name: Flutter kicks
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, quick alternating kicks

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over and under

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply
